title: Modified Entropy from Action Principle (Dehyadegari & Sheykhi)
efc_relevance: Derives a modified horizon entropy directly from an f(Ricci, Kretschmann) action that yields modified Friedmann equations free of higher derivatives, with the entropy obtained via the gravity-thermodynamics correspondence. Direct ontological cousin of EFC: same action-principle-to-entropy derivation strategy, but EFC routes through the S(r,t) field while this paper routes through curvature invariants — clean comparison surface for WP1 recovery-conditions.
ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger under cluster emergent-entropic-gravity; cross-reference framework:Jacobson-1995, framework:Padmanabhan-2009, and arXiv:2604.19831 (Van der Waals gravity); required ontological-comparison row in WP1 recovery-conditions table — under what limit does EFC's S(r,t) action reduce to this f(Ricci, Kretschmann) entropy?
